results.prop: O1 the observation invariants are jointly satisfiable
results.formula: exists obs: N1 & I1 & I2 & I3 & I4

results.prop: O2 N1 ranges: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
results.formula: exists obs: others & !(form_err >= 0  and  t_ok >= 0  and  d_min <= D_NONE)
results.note: excludes: negative errors or durations; distances beyond the sentinel

results.prop: O2 I1 priority only at the queue point: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
results.formula: exists obs: others & !(has_prio -> at_queue)
results.note: excludes: has_prio & !at_queue: a drone away from its queue point believing it may commit (the commit guard also requires at_queue, so this state would be a latent defect, not a commit)

results.prop: O2 I2 the queue point lies in the approach zone: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
results.formula: exists obs: others & !(at_queue -> mutex_zone)
results.note: excludes: at_queue & !mutex_zone: the automaton would follow the formation (or recover) while queued, and the yield/commit edges, which require mutex_zone, could never fire for that drone

results.prop: O2 I3 a passed gate is out of the approach zone: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
results.formula: exists obs: others & !(passed -> !mutex_zone)
results.note: excludes: passed & mutex_zone: approach/yield/commit and pass_done would both describe the same gate

results.prop: O2 I4 t_ok counts only while the own slot error is ok: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
results.formula: exists obs: others & !(t_ok > 0 -> form_err < e_ok)
results.note: excludes: t_ok > 0 with form_err >= e_ok (a stale 'ok for t seconds' counter)

results.prop: O5 monitor: any observation -> exactly one edge; inconsistent -> only the fault edge to FAILSAFE
results.formula: sense_ok' = sense_ok & consistent: exactly one guard, and !consistent -> target FAILSAFE

results.prop: Q1 calm, not committed, at the queue point -> commit or yield (every mode)
results.formula: at_queue -> enabled edge in {commit, yield}

results.prop: Om1 mutation: without I2 a queued drone takes a formation edge (Q1 must fail)
results.formula: expect counterexample

results.prop: Om2 mutation: v1 constraint passed -> at_queue makes pass_done unreachable
results.formula: expect UNSAT (reachability lost)
results.note: v1 formal/common.Obs.legal had passed -> at_queue; with I2 and I3 no 'passed' observation remains, so a proof over that domain says nothing about the exit edge

results.prop: Om3 mutation: no monitor -> an inconsistent observation drives a mission edge
results.formula: expect counterexample
